efficiency /= pool->workers;

```c
if (pool->workers != 0) {
    efficiency /= pool->workers;
}
```

This conditional check ensures that the division only occurs if `pool->workers` is not zero, thus preventing the division by zero error and ensuring the function behaves correctly even when there are no workers in the pool.
